isa_checks.scope: Function-body emulation: division-based canonical reference, every required input access, failure nonwrites, unaligned output, aliases, unsigned large sizes, source/guards, preserved registers, stack and DF where applicable.
isa_checks.limitations: Not a native hardware/ELF-loader or operating-system test. Native NASM fixture is a separate execution mode.
